carve60.note: frame is 1080x2232 at display origin [0,108]; the band is reported in display coordinates by adding the origin.

method: SSIM grayscale, non-overlapping 8x8 windows, C1=0.01, C2=0.03; device.png is 380x806 covering display y=108..2400, so the report frame is cropped at display y=108 and resized to 380x806 with Lanczos. Same implementation for before and after; the absolute recomputed before differs from GR1's 0.84854 because the original script was not committed.
device_gesture_note: The Moto G35 reference reports a 108 px status-bar inset and an 80 px bottom gesture/navigation inset (the GR1 metrics file calls the latter 'mandatory-gesture bottom 80'); react-native-safe-area-context reads navigationBars, so nav=80 reproduces the device footer. nav=60 (24 dp at 400 dpi) is the synthetic API-34 profile default and lands 20 px low.
